issue.title: Fix Tasks PNG setup failing to select Artifacts PRs tab
issue.description: While verifying the Tasks pane file split, tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_tasks.py reproducibly timed out before opening TasksPane: after page.press("5"), expect_state("artifacts_subtab", "prs") observed "files" for 5 seconds. It failed both under the default visual worker count and SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1. Diagnose the Artifacts tab setup/keybinding or make this visual fixture navigate deterministically, then rerun the focused visual test.
